criteria.text: Noor remains healthy at the deployed release throughout remediation.
Log rotation validates and runs without duplicate entries, with one explicit rotation owner for Noor logs.
Swap pressure is addressed without OOM events, service restarts, or avoidable production latency.
relay.starec.ai certificate renewal is restored or stale renewal ownership is safely retired with evidence and rollback.
Failed Polska scheduled jobs are repaired and safely validated without uncontrolled external collection.
Wazzup unexpected-channel warnings are resolved or proven to be correct fail-closed protective filtering without sending real messages.
One root-owned final host and public API acceptance is green, and all remaining limits are explicit.
